leads.title: [ESPAÑOL] Looking for an n8n + AI Automation Builder for ongoing freelance work
leads.description: Hi everyone, We’re NUBO , a small AI implementation agency building AI agents, automations and integrations for companies in Spain and Latin America. n8n is a core part of our technical stack. We’re looking for an experienced n8n builder to work with us on an ongoing, project-by-project basis as our workload grows. We’re not necessarily looking for a senior software developer, we’re looking for someone who is very comfortable with n8n, AI tools and integrations, and who can take well-defined tasks and build them independently. What the work looks like: Building and maintaining n8n workflows for AI agents and business automations. Integrating LLMs such as OpenAI, Claude and Gemini. Working with APIs, webhooks, CRMs, WhatsApp/messaging platforms and databases. Configuring prompts and agent logic. Troubleshooting and improving existing workflows. Occasionally writing or modifying small pieces of JavaScript/Python with the help of AI coding tools such as Claude Code. Configure and mantain automations in Go High Level. Working on different client projects across sales, customer service and operations. We provide the architecture, requirements and guidance for each project. Your role is
leads.raw: [ESPAÑOL] Looking for an n8n + AI Automation Builder for ongoing freelance work

outreach.subject: Quick idea for "[ESPAÑOL] Looking for an n8n + AI Automation "
outreach.body:
Hi,

Saw your post: "[ESPAÑOL] Looking for an n8n + AI Automation Builder for ongoing freelance work". This is exactly the kind of ai agents work I do.

Here is how I would approach it:
1. A short scoping call to lock the outcome (30 min).
2. A working prototype delivered in 48-72h.
3. Handover with documentation, plus optional ongoing support.

I usually start with a small fixed-price pilot ($150-$500) so you can see it working before committing further.

Three questions so I can quote precisely: what does success look like, which tools are already in place, and what is your deadline?

Reply here or email me and I will send a 2-minute walkthrough of a near-identical build.

Reserve the pilot here (pay and I start immediately): https://paypal.me/7900861
Best,
